name: S3 Huahin Hotel
detail: The location is very convenient. There is parking available. The room is clean. We came as a family and had a family room with 2 large beds, which we liked very much. Next time we come to Hua Hin, we will come back here again.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: The Yana Villas Hua Hin
detail: The accommodation is conveniently located with a great spot next to Hua Hin beach at a reasonable price. The rooms are spacious and clean, and the staff provides good service. It is suitable for vacations with family or couples. The breakfast does not offer a wide variety of options, but it is sufficient for general dining.
area: Khao Takiab Beach Front,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: RELO' The Urban Escape
detail: At first, I saw comments saying that it was not close to the city center and that taking a taxi was inconvenient. Since I wasn't driving, I hesitated to book. Later, I did a lot of research and found that it was actually easy to book a taxi, so I decided to go ahead! Firstly, in terms of transportation, Grab is easy to use, but it takes about 30 minutes to get to the city. If you plan to frequently eat or play in the city, it might not be very suitable. Secondly, the hardware facilities are great; there is a swimming pool and a gym, and the gym overlooks the sea, which is fantastic! However, the room is smaller than I expected, but the balcony faces the sea, which is absolutely beautiful! The bathroom is also quite large; although the decor is not very fancy or Instagrammable, it's sufficient! Additionally, the complimentary spa has a buy one get one free offer, which I highly recommend. It's not expensive, and the experience is great; the massage was very comfortable! Lastly, the breakfast was actually quite good over the two days; the variety was rich and the taste was nice! One small complaint is that the laundry service provided is too expensive, so I ended up taking my laundry back to Bangkok to wash.
area: Hua Hin Beachfront,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Maven Stylish Hotel Hua Hin
detail: The location is convenient for going to both the station and the night market, situated along a main road in the best spot. The front desk has staff available 24 hours a day, and they called a tuk-tuk for me when I went out. The staff, both male and female, were all very friendly. I stayed for 10 nights this time. On the day before the last day, during breakfast, a cake with my name saying Thank you for 10 days was presented, and I was very touched by this wonderful hospitality. The breakfast varied with different dishes each day, so I never got bored over the 10 days. I brought my Fire TV Stick and watched videos in my room, but the Wi-Fi was weak during that time, so I rated it 4 stars. This is an outstanding hotel with no complaints.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Chaba Chalet
detail: The room is as described, with cool air conditioning, clean, and no musty smell. It's suitable for budget-conscious people who just need a place to sleep, as you'll be out exploring during the day. The location is very good, close to the train station and the night market. It would be great if there was a hairdryer available too.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Hotel Alley Hua Hin
detail: Good accommodation, convenient. The owner is very nice and carried the bags to the room. Close to the beach, just a short walk. A 7-Eleven is located right at the entrance of the alley.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Chalelarn Hotel
detail: Affordable hotel, clean, with good service staff, close to restaurants and the community. The rooftop pool has a great view, the water is clean, and the bedding is clean with a soft mattress. If there is an opportunity, I will stay again.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Hua Hin Grand Hotel & Plaza
detail: The hotel is not located on the beach side as there's a road in between; it is slightly opposite the Marriott hotel. The hotel is next to a Korean restaurant and not far from the night market and Hua Hin train station. When parking in front of the lobby, the staff is very helpful and there is plenty of parking space. During check-in, the staff provided good service and was ready with complete information. Taking the glass elevator up to the room offered a nice view. Upon entering the room, it appeared clean and had a reasonable amount of amenities (though there were no plugs at the head of the bed). The Wi-Fi signal was consistently fast (the TV picture was not very clear, but I didn't watch it much). The air conditioning worked well, and the sea view was beautiful. I stayed with my family in 2 rooms and overall, I was very impressed.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Plaza Huahin
detail: It's easy to walk from the train station and very close to the beach. The room is very nice, clean, and has enough towels for everyone. There's a safe for opening and closing hours. At night, I slept comfortably with no noise from the neighboring rooms. You can only hear people talking outside when you're in the room because ours is on the ground floor, so you can hear passing people a bit, but it's not bothersome. The price is good, and the location is okay. It's worth it when shared with friends.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Nid Huahin Hotel
detail: We checked in at 9 PM. The reception staff was very friendly. The bedroom is very nice, clean, and has a cool air conditioner. The bathroom is excellent, with strong water flow and hot water. There is a clothes drying rack, a fan, a TV, and a refrigerator, everything you need in one room. Plus, breakfast is included, and it feels safe too. If you're traveling alone or looking for a good hotel at a great price, we booked it for over 400 baht. I definitely recommend it because it's worth the price.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map
